title: Completion tree with a known initial value
statement: Let $b,s\in\{0,1,2\}$ and let $x$ be a sign assignment on the nine coordinates indexed by $\{0,1,2\}^2$. The completion tree for block $b$ and seed $s$, supplied with the value of $x$ at its initial coordinate, evaluates to the majority of the three signs in block $b$ of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign assignment on nine coordinates
